summary: RLI Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a $2.00 special cash dividend (~$184M total) and a $0.18 regular quarterly dividend (12.5% increase), both payable June 12, 2026 to shareholders of record May 29, 2026. The Board also authorized a $250 million share repurchase program with no expiration, allowing open market or private transactions. These actions reflect disciplined capital management, returning excess cash to shareholders while maintaining flexibility for growth. The 51st consecutive annual dividend increase underscores financial strength. Watch for future repurchase execution pace and potential earnings impact from the special dividend.
